summary: Configured node1 to back up /srv/inventory/data daily to /var/backups/inventory and retain exactly the seven newest archives. Backup creation, retention, archive integrity, source equivalence, scheduling, and persistence through a node reboot were verified.
actions_performed: Installed a root-owned backup script that creates integrity-checked compressed archives and prunes only after successful creation.
Installed and enabled a persistent systemd timer scheduled daily at midnight.
Exercised the retention boundary and confirmed exactly seven valid archives remain.
Safely rebooted node1 once and verified its changed boot identity and complete recovery.

evidence.summary: A real backup completed successfully. The timer is enabled, active, persistent, and scheduled with OnCalendar=*-*-* 00:00:00; the latest archive matches the live source.

evidence.requirement: Retain the seven most recent backups
evidence.summary: After creating more than seven backups, exactly seven remained. Every retained archive passed integrity validation.

Captured healthy baseline boot ID f9031a39-89d7-426a-ae19-a60bfdcd23e1, received delayed native reboot acknowledgement, observed changed boot ID 761df55d-ab9d-4b5d-a607-fb927dc9012e, and proved timer, archived data, retention, and new backup creation recovered after restart.
